heading: Thursday, April 17, 2025
topLine: Google previews Gemini 2.5 Flash with adjustable thinking.

items.headline: Google previews Gemini 2.5 Flash with adjustable thinking
items.summary: Google describes Gemini 2.5 Flash as its first fully hybrid reasoning model: developers can turn thinking on or off and set a thinking budget of up to 24,576 tokens. It launched in preview in the Gemini API, AI Studio, Vertex AI and the Gemini app.
